companies.name: Sprouts.ai
companies.discription: Designed production Generative AI and NLP pipelines for enterprise contact enrichment using LLM reasoning, semantic retrieval, entity resolution, and Elasticsearch to support reliable enrichment and search. Built production AI inference and retrieval services using Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face Transformers, TensorFlow, and PyTorch for chat, embeddings, batch processing, ranking, and semantic search. Owned two production FastAPI microservices for enrichment orchestration with PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Redis, JWT, OAuth2, Alembic, multi-tenant RBAC, async processing, caching, rate limiting, and bulk processing. Developed full-stack features in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Vite, and Tailwind CSS—intelligence dashboards, relationship discovery, network visualizations, hierarchy views, and AI-powered workflows—collaborating on designs with Figma and Claude Design. Built AI test automation for a live LLM-powered Search API using concurrent requests and query-regression testing, identifying a 41.6% failure rate across 3 root causes and establishing a 58.4% baseline pass rate that informed parser fixes and production release validation. Traced contradictory contact emails to an Elasticsearch read path: person records resolved through the search alias into a backing index, then a fixed field-order lookup accepted any non-empty email—including leftover previous-employer addresses—without checking whether the domain still matched the current company. Added a domain-match gate before treating a cached email as resolved; on mismatch, skip the stale document fields and re-run the verification waterfall. Operated services on Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, and Helm.

companies.name: TekGigz LLC
companies.discription: Built a finance-focused web application with Python, Flask, Django, and PostgreSQL for transaction processing, vendor management, and real-time financial reporting. Delivered secure REST APIs (−20% response time), optimized PostgreSQL schemas and SQL (+25% query performance), and built responsive HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript reporting dashboards (−10% user support requests). Created automated test suites with PyTest and CI/CD with Jenkins/Docker (−15% deploy issues, +30% release speed) on Heroku.

companies.name: PTC Onshape Inc.
companies.discription: Contributed to a cloud-based engineering design platform by building scalable error-handling infrastructure and performance-optimized frontend components. Designed a custom data structure to detect and propagate errors across interconnected engineering models, shipped modular React/Angular components with model validators and real-time error indicators, and improved frontend responsiveness by ~20% while integrating modules into Jenkins/Docker CI/CD.
